target_customer: UX researchers and product managers at software companies
problem: Teams kept interviews, notes and findings scattered across tools, so research insights were hard to find and reuse.
product_category: User research repository and analysis tool

founders.name: Adam Green
founders.background_notes: YC bio calls him a product design and building generalist.

technical_complexity.rationale: Transcription, tagging and report generation built on existing speech and web components.

defensibility.rationale: A research notes hub with no data or network effect, easy to copy or replace with general tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not found. Later research repository tools such as Dovetail and Condens became established, per 2026 roundups.

market_need_then: Not documented by a source dated near 2018. The company's own Product Hunt post says the founders built it out of frustration with existing tools.

branding.domain_note: userhero.io is the domain a Product Hunt listing uses; userhero.io today describes a customer-signal inbox, which may be a different or later product.

identity.logo: Lowercase userhero.io wordmark with a logo image, per the live site

brand_strength.rationale: No press, mascot or community evidence found, and the name is easily confused with HelpHero and other Hero named tools.

outcome_analysis: The YC directory lists User Hero as Inactive with a team of three, but no shutdown post, acquisition or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public. No funding was found either. A current userhero.io site describes a different customer-signal inbox product, which suggests the domain or idea may have been continued or reused, but sources do not confirm who runs it.
notes: Cause of inactivity not public. No competitor with a source dated near 2018 was found; searches returned only 2026 roundups of research repository tools, so the list is empty. No funding found beyond the standard YC deal. The loot-drop.io page is unreliable and was not used. Whether userhero.io is the same company is unconfirmed.
